prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the passenger in a rear-end collision in Pasadena, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1223; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd prefer not to give my name on the recording, but I can confirm I was a passenger in the vehicle involved.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where the collision happened?
A: It was on a main road in Pasadena, Texas, near a busy intersection with a lot of traffic lights.
Q: Where were you seated at the time, and what were you doing?
A: I was in the front passenger seat. We were stopped at a red light, waiting to turn.
Q: What happened next?
A: The car behind us didn't stop in time. We felt a hard jolt from behind and my head snapped forward and then back against the seat.
Q: Did you hit anything inside the vehicle?
A: No, I didn't hit the dashboard or the window. It was mainly the whiplash motion that I noticed.
Q: When did you first notice pain or stiffness?
A: Within an hour or so I had a dull ache in my neck. By the next morning it was stiff and I had trouble turning my head to the left.
Q: Have you seen a doctor or received any treatment?
A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic. They diagnosed a neck strain and gave me a muscle relaxant and a referral for physical therapy.
Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms today?
A: Yes, though it's improving. Sitting for long periods and looking over my shoulder when driving still bothers me.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm following the treatment plan and I'm willing to provide the clinic records you request.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
A: Thank you.
